{{Quote|&hellip;Of a time in ages long forgotten when ceaseless ''war'' raged from rim to rim of the entire galaxy;|The Keeper's history lesson|<ref name="TKS" />}}
An '''unidentified war''' was waged long before [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. According to [[the Keeper]] the war raged throughout the entire [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], from rim to rim. The [[Keeper's makers]] were a non-violent race, and as the war reached their [[Keeper's World system/Legends|star system]] they chose to flee to parts unknown. They created and left behind the Keeper to restore their [[Keeper's World|planet]] after the war's conclusion, in the hopes that they might one day return.<ref name="TKS" />
